title: Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05437v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). These second-order expectations, known as metanorms, govern how people respond when social rules are broken. We introduce a novel framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) along two dimensions: emotional appraisal and behavioral response, and propose new classification tasks, namely, predicting self-regulation in violators, and other-regulation in observers. We release a multi-perspective dataset, NormReact, of 450 norm violation scenarios, hand-annotated for emotions and behavioral responses across norm violators' gender and observers' social closeness. translated_title: 超越对与错：评估大语言模型中的二阶社会推理能力
translated_abstract: 先前的AI对齐研究主要集中在一阶社会规范上——即教会模型什么是社会上可接受或不可接受的行为（例如“不要偷窃”）。然而，社会智能不仅依赖于对规范的识别，还依赖于预判谁将执行这些规范以及如何执行（例如公开羞辱甚至监禁）。这些二阶期望被称为“元规范”，它们支配着人们在社交规则被打破时的反应方式。我们引入了一个新颖的框架，从两个维度评估大语言模型中的元规范推理能力：情绪评价和行为反应，并提出了新的分类任务，即预测违规者的自我调节行为和观察者的他人调节行为。我们发布了一个多视角数据集NormReact，其中包含450个规范违规场景，并针对违规者的性别和观察者的社会亲密度，对情绪和行为反应进行了人工标注。当前的大语言模型表现出……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估大语言模型元规范推理（二阶社会推理）能力的新框架，并发布了包含450个人工标注规范违规场景的多视角数据集NormReact，用于预测违规者的自我调节和观察者的他人调节反应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel framework for evaluating metanorm (second-order social reasoning) capabilities in LLMs and releases NormReact, a multi-perspective dataset of 450 hand-annotated norm violation scenarios for predicting self-regulation in violators and other-regulation in observers.
